'''Storm Squad''' was a squad in service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was stationed on the ''[[Dorin's Sky]]'' when it was attacked by an Imperial boarding party and most of its members were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in action.
